description: A lazygit-style workspace: numbered side panels for a shell and Git changes beside the chat, with focus keys, screen modes and a panel registry

keybinding.title: Key overrides
keybinding.description: Action to key, or <disabled>: panel_1 to panel_9, main, left, left_alt, right, right_alt, next, help, mode_next, mode_previous, tab_previous, tab_next, focus_shell

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: panels (ids), side (left or right), ratio ([side, chat]) and portrait (columns below which panels stack)
